name: X-Inertia request receives the JSON page object with X-Inertia and Vary headers
notes: Upstream example uses encryptHistory: true; the golden route enables it per page. Upstream sends Vary: X-Inertia; Nestvexa appends the content-selecting partial-reload headers (cache-poisoning hardening, SEC-030), so the upstream value is checked as a prefix and the full list in tests/cache-poisoning.test.ts.
